display.purpose: Hero headline and page-level H1s only — Space Grotesk, reserved for genuine headings and trusted numbers (SGPA/CGPA/attendance).

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and descriptions — Inter, capped ~65-75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, stat-card titles, nav items, badges — Inter, medium weight.

micro.purpose: Dominant dense-caption size (11px) — stat-card subtitles, timetable popover details, today's-classes status text.

micro-sub.purpose: Second, more de-emphasized tier (10px) directly under a Micro line — 'Updated {date}', '% Complete', compact day headers.

micro-dense.purpose: Tightest contexts only (9px) — Weekly Timetable hour ticks and grid-cell slot content, the LIVE NOW badge.

shadows.name: glass-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default resting shadow under every glass card and glass button (light mode value; dark mode swaps to 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)).

shadows.name: dropdown-shadow
shadows.purpose: Heavier, more opaque shadow for floating menus/popovers so underlying content never bleeds through.

shadows.name: arrow-btn-glow
shadows.purpose: Tight colored halo around the circular scroll-arrow affordance.

motion.name: ease-out-strong
motion.purpose: Shared entrance/exit easing token (EASE_OUT in lib/utils.ts) used across the app's Framer Motion transitions.

motion.name: press-fast
motion.purpose: Transform-only active:scale-[0.98] press feedback on buttons, decoupled from the slower 200ms color/shadow transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The signature CTA treatment — indigo-to-violet gradient fill, used sparingly for the single most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(to right, #6366f1, #8b5cf6); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(99,102,241,0.25); transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(99,102,241,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent fill, hairline border, backdrop blur.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fafafa; background: transparent; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The dominant surface of the whole system — translucent gradient fill, blurred, thinly bordered in low-alpha indigo, ambient tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-card-glass { border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.03)); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #fafafa; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-glass__title { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #a7a7ae; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-glass__value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Flat (non-glass) surface — one of the few places the system uses a plain neutral fill instead of translucent glass.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fafafa; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(167,167,174,0.7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99,102,241,0.5); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Flat top-level navigation link — no underline, tint-only hover/active states.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #a7a7ae; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fafafa; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #fafafa; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }

narrative.overview:
UPESphere reads like a fintech dashboard for a student's academic life, not a calculator site. It's a near-black console in dark mode (an airy near-white one in light mode) where every panel is a soft indigo-violet glass surface — translucent, blurred, thinly bordered — floating on a faint colored glow instead of a hard shadow. PRODUCT.md's brief that students should "check regularly, the way they'd check a banking app" is a literal design instruction here: dark-by-default like a trading terminal, one saturated identity gradient (indigo → violet, occasionally → cyan) reserved for calls to action, the wordmark, and numbers that matter — everything else stays quiet.

It explicitly rejects the "free calculator site" look named in PRODUCT.md's anti-references: no banner-ad chrome, no cartoon mascots, no gamified badge clutter. Precision reads as restraint — flat neutral surfaces, one accent hue family, glass instead of gray boxes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-by-default (next-themes, defaultTheme="dark"), with full light-mode parity through paired HSL tokens.
One identity gradient — indigo → violet, occasionally → cyan — carried by glass borders, shadows, focus rings, CTAs, and the wordmark, never the whole screen.
Elevation expressed as blur + tinted glow, never a flat drop shadow.
Space Grotesk display type over Inter body type: a geometric, slightly technical heading voice over a humanist reading voice.
Color as trust signal, not decoration — used sparingly enough that its appearance always means "this matters."

rules.name: The Glass-Not-Flat Rule
rules.body: A "surface" in this system is rarely a flat neutral swatch — it's a translucent gradient (--glass-from → --glass-to) over a backdrop-blur, bordered in low-alpha indigo (--glass-border) rather than the flat --border token. Reach for the flat neutral tokens only on genuinely flat controls (inputs, secondary buttons); everything meant to feel "raised" is glass.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: Indigo → violet (→ cyan) is the only gradient in the system. It appears on primary CTAs, the wordmark, and at most one emphasized phrase per headline — never on body copy, never stacked on more than one heading per screen.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: font-display (Space Grotesk) marks a genuine heading or a number the student is meant to trust (SGPA, CGPA, attendance %) — not every bold word. Body and UI chrome stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Blur-Over-Black Rule
rules.body: Elevation is blur plus a colored glow, never a flat gray drop shadow. A shadow with no indigo/violet tint reads as a bug, not a stylistic choice.

dos: Do keep the indigo → violet gradient to primary CTAs, the wordmark, and at most one emphasized headline phrase per screen.
Do express elevation as blur plus an indigo/violet-tinted shadow (--glass-shadow), never a flat black drop shadow.
Do anchor popovers' transform-origin to their trigger so scale-in animations read as originating from the click point.
Do check body and placeholder text against its actual background before shipping — the dark near-black canvas needs near-white text, not mid-gray "for elegance."
Do gate hover-only transform effects behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) so touch input never gets stuck in a hover state.
donts: Don't ship a cluttered, ad-heavy "free calculator" look — this is PRODUCT.md's explicit anti-reference: no banner-ad chrome, no cartoon mascots, no gamified badge clutter.
Don't add a second gradient-text treatment to the same screen — one wordmark or one emphasized phrase, never both plus every card heading too.
Don't nest glass on glass (a GlassCard inside another GlassCard) — one translucent layer per surface, flat neutral tokens underneath it.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on cards or list rows — a full border, a background tint, or a leading icon instead.
Don't drop a plain gray box-shadow (e.g. rgba(0,0,0,0.2) with no hue) onto a raised surface — every shadow in this system carries the indigo/violet tint.
